title: Suspect dies after being shot by Ottawa police
article: A Montreal man who was shot by police following a car chase on Ottawa's Highway 417 Wednesday has died in hospital.
Richard Bastien, 43, died at the Ottawa Hospital's Civic Campus Friday afternoon, said Ottawa police.

Ontario's Special Investigations Unit said earlier Friday that it was continuing its investigation into the shooting. The SIU was called in Wednesday and closed a section of the highway overnight to investigate the site of the incident.
At around 6 p.m. ET on Wednesday, Ottawa police responded to a call about a shooting on Bearhill Road, just off March Road in the city's west end.
When they arrived, police said they found Rainer Elsner, 65, suffering from three wounds.
A description of the suspect in the shooting and his vehicle was issued to police, who shortly after spotted a vehicle matching the description on Highway 417.
According to an SIU media release, police pursued the vehicle along Highway 417 until it stopped near the intersection of Walkley Road in the city's south end.
Bastien got out of the car and interacted with three officers, said the release, and then produced a handgun.
The SIU said an officer fired a number of shots and Bastien was struck.
Elsner and Bastien were taken to hospital.
In its investigation, the SIU has designated four officers as witnesses to the shooting.
The SIU has asked anyone who may have any information on the shootings to contact the unit at 416-622-1898 or call toll free at 1-800-787-8529, ext. 1957.
Ottawa police have said they are continuing to investigate the first shooting, which they have said appears to be an attempted murder.
